$comment: THE EXPLICIT HARNESS LIST. scripts/run-harnesses.cjs runs exactly these files and nothing else.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: on 17 September 2026 a verification sweep written as `ls scripts/*.cjs` ran
scripts/migrate-from-sheets.cjs against the LIVE database with the service role — 132 rows of
public.discovery_trucks overwritten and 19 inserted in 1.2 seconds. See
docs/discovery-upsert-incident-report.md. A glob cannot tell a proof from a migration; a list can.
RULE: never glob scripts/. Add a new harness HERE or the runner will report it as unregistered.

excluded.$comment: Every other scripts/*.cjs file, with the reason it is NOT in the list above. The runner checks this covers the directory.

operational_refused.$why: Builds a real client and WRITES to production. The runner refuses these by source inspection even if someone lists one.

operational_read_only.$why: Talks to live Stripe/Supabase. Read-only today, but it is an operational tool, not a proof, and it must never run unattended.

server.$why: A long-running local TCP server. It never exits, so a sequential runner would hang on it (it held the 17 Sep sweep for 200s).

shared_modules.$why: Required BY the harnesses. They export helpers and assert nothing, so running them proves nothing.

fixture_generators.$why: 🔴 THESE REWRITE THE COMMITTED GOLDEN FIXTURES. Running them in a sweep would silently regenerate the baseline that batch-rolling-identity.cjs and batch-reservation-golden-on.cjs check AGAINST, turning both proofs into tautologies. Run by hand, deliberately, only from a build whose harnesses already pass.
